claim: OU text in the first person, snappier

suggestion.to: Our Centre for Electronic Imaging (CEI) played a lead role in characterising the CCD273 detectors in Euclid’s VIS instrument, and developed ‘trap pumping’, now used in orbit. It pinpoints individual radiation-damage defects in the detectors to within a fraction of a pixel, so images can be corrected and kept precise enough to trace dark matter through gravitational lensing. Our astronomers also lead searches of Euclid’s surveys for rare gravitational lenses.
